name: Balance dungeon spawns are real creatures scaled per actor instance
contract: balance_spawn creates an ordinary (non-summon) creature inside the caller's own dungeon instance, at the requested level, so creature_classlevelstats and CoA dungeon health scaling apply exactly as for a native spawn. Scarlet Soldier (4286) has creature_template HealthModifier 4 and creature_classlevelstats level 36 class 1 basehp0 1277 in the test world DB, Rate.Creature.Elite.Elite.HP is 1 and CoA.CreatureScaling.Dungeon.Health is 2.5 by default, so a level-36 spawn's max health is ceil(1277*4)*1*2.5 = 12770. Two unrelated players who are not grouped and teleport to the same dungeon spot each get their own instance (MapMgr hands out a strictly increasing instance id per new instance), so their instance_id metrics differ and the spawn each creates is isolated to its own instance.

steps.label: A level-36 Scarlet Soldier balance spawn gets CoA's dungeon health scaling
The second player's balance spawn is scaled the same way in its own instance
Ungrouped players entering the same dungeon spot land in different instances
